title: Does amplitude or rotation encoding preserve digit similarity better?
rationale: On 200 training and 100 held-out digit images, a squared-fidelity kernel from amplitude encoding improves classification accuracy by at least five percentage points over a product RY-rotation kernel at angle_scale=0.25, using the same ridge classifier.
